basic_details.job_title: SMC Honorary Coach Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online 8 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC) has announced 8 vacancies for the Honorary Coach post on a contractual basis for a tenure of 11 months. The posts include Table Tennis Coach, Badminton Coach, Volleyball Coach, Kho-Kho Coach, Kabaddi Coach, Judo Coach, Karate Coach, and Gym Coach. Qualifications vary by post as specified in the official notification, with a maximum age limit of 50 years and a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 10,000 for applicable posts with no other allowances. Eligible candidates can apply online between 15 October 2026 11:00 AM and 24 October 2026 11:00 PM. The selection process

how_to_apply: Visit the official Surat Municipal Corporation website at https://www.suratmunicipal.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: SMC Honorary Coach at a Glance

rows.details: South Zone (Udhana), New Sports Complex Dindoli
Honorary Coach (Table Tennis, Badminton, Volleyball, Kho-Kho, Kabaddi, Judo, Karate, Gym)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment drive offers a total of 8 vacancies for various sports coaching positions at the newly constructed sports complex in Dindoli under the South Zone of Surat Municipal Corporation. Below is the post-wise vacancy distribution:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the requisite qualifications and experience specified for the respective coaching discipline: Sports Qualification: NIS diploma or its equivalent degree, or Sports Authority of India (SAI) 6-month certificate course and at least one year of coaching experience. Alternatively, C.P.Ed./D.P.Ed./M.P.Ed. qualification and physical fitness as a physical training instructor. Alternatively, H.S.C. pass with participation at national/state level in the relevant sport or one year of coaching experience. Preference: Candidates who have won medals in national or state level tournaments for the concerned sport will be given preference during selection.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a fixed consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand Rupees only) . No other allowances, perks, or financial benefits of any other kind will be payable. The engagement is made on a contractual basis through the Standing Committee resolution for a fixed duration of 11 months.

content_sections.heading: SMC Honorary Coach Job Description
content_sections.text: Coaches appointed under this recruitment will be responsible for conducting training sessions, imparting structured sports coaching, maintaining training discipline, and preparing teams for competitions at the newly constructed sports complex located at Dindoli in the South Zone of Surat Municipal Corporation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SMC Honorary Coach
content_sections.text: Visit the official Surat Municipal Corporation website at https://www.suratmunicipal.gov.in . Complete the User Registration by entering your E-mail Address, Mobile Number, and the verification Captcha, then click Next. Verify your mobile number by entering the OTP received. Complete your account setup by entering your First Name, Last Name, and creating a password, then click Submit. Verify your email address via the verification link sent to your inbox and log in. Fill out your personal details, educational qualifications, and experience details in the User Profile section. Upload scanned copies of your photograph and signature in JPG/JPEG or PNG format (Photo size up to 150 KB, Signature size up to 50 KB). Select the relevant sports coaching post under Apply Now, review all entered details carefully, and submit the application. Save a printout of the final application form for your records and future verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process is based on scrutiny of registered applications, verification of original documents, and meeting the required eligibility criteria and qualifications. Eligible candidates will be called for document verification and walk-in interview sessions. The exact schedule, date, and venue for document verification will be communicated via SMS to the candidate's registered mobile number.

faq.question: Q1. What is SMC Honorary Coach Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by Surat Municipal Corporation to engage 8 Honorary Coaches on a contractual basis for 11 months at the sports complex in Dindoli.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available for various sports coaching positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 24 October 2026 up to 11:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an NIS diploma, SAI certificate course with 1 year experience, C.P.Ed./D.P.Ed./M.P.Ed. degree, or H.S.C. with participation at national/state level or 1 year of coaching experience depending on the post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 50 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee for these posts.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the SMC Honorary Coach post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official Surat Municipal Corporation website by completing user registration, filling out the profile, uploading documents, and submitting the application form.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises registration scrutiny, document verification, and a merit list prepared based on qualifications and guidelines set by the Standing Committee.

faq.question: Q9. What salary will selected coaches receive?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly remuneration of Rs. 10,000/-.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual engagement for a tenure of 11 months under the standing committee resolution of Surat Municipal Corporation.
